plain: On April 24th, 1964, the story goes, a police officer named Lonnie Zamora in Socorro, New Mexico, saw an egg-shaped craft land, and afterwards found burnt plants on the ground where it had been. The documentary maker James Fox has investigated the case himself. He leans on the investigator Ray Stanford and on Stanford's account, Socorro Saucer in a Pentagon Pantry, and he also mentions the astronomer J. Allen Hynek. Fox goes further than most: he says Zamora "locked eyes with one of these beings." Michels brings the case up in several episodes in his own words. He calls Zamora "this police officer" who "sees this egg actually land, sees burnt vegetation in the area," and in another episode he says the craft "allegedly had little legs." If it is true, it is a landing seen up close by a police officer, with marks left on the ground.
